response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.healtheval AS h, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / NULLIF(sc.spanmin, 0)) AS rate, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scans sc JOIN sites s ON sc.zoneref = s.zoneregistry GROUP BY s.healtheval), a AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS ar FROM g) SELECT AVG(g.rate) AS avg_rate, AVG(g.cnt) AS avg_count, AVG(g.rate - a.ar) AS avg_excess FROM g, a WHERE g.rate > a.ar
